subject: Pen test closure: evidence package, config screenshots & compensating controls
messages:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finco.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finco.com
Date: 2026-06-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Pen test follow-up - request for remediation evidence

Hi Olga,

Thanks for sending the executive summary last week. Our InfoSec team reviewed the findings and we'd like to close out a few remaining items before we sign off on the integration. Can you please provide: 

- A copy of the final penetration test report (redacted is fine) you referenced.
- Screenshots of the firewall / IP allowlist rules that were changed during remediation.
- The Jira ticket(s) where the fixes were tracked (we need ticket history and comments).
- For the SSO findings: an audit log extract showing the test account's login attempts post-fix.

If possible, bundle these into a single folder or zip and share a Drive link. We may need to attach a couple of artifacts to our SIG assessment. Are there any compensating controls in place while you complete the remaining verification steps?

Best,
Sam
Sam Turner
Senior Security Engineer, FinCo
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18 11:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up - request for remediation evidence

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the clear list. We're assembling a closure package now. Quick summary of what we'll provide by EOD Friday (our timezone):

1) Final pen test report (redacted PII and internal IPs) — attachment: redwood-pt-report-202605.pdf
2) Firewall / allowlist snapshots — annotated PNGs showing the rule and timestamp — attachment: fw-allowlist-snapshot-olga-20260618.png
3) Jira export for tracking: PT-4878 + comments + status transitions (thread extract txt) — attachment: jira-PT-4878-thread-extract.txt
4) SSO audit export for the test account (CSV) and a short note describing how the test was re-run after the fix.
5) A short compensating-controls memo describing temporary mitigations we used during remediation: WAF rules tightened, short-lived IP allowlist for the test window, increased MFA enforcement for admin accounts, and continuous log monitoring (SIEM rule references).

Two requests from our side before we share screenshots publicly: please confirm if FinCo needs redaction of any hostnames or IP ranges in the artifacts, and whether you prefer Drive link permissions set to 'anyone with link' or only invited viewers.

I'll attach the Drive link once Monica and Karthik sign off on the screenshots.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finco.com>
Date: 2026-06-19 08:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up - request for remediation evidence

Olga / Karthik —

I've pulled the firewall console screenshots and the Jira export. Couple of internal notes before we share externally:

- The firewall screenshot includes internal CIDR blocks and a temporary management IP; I'll crop and blur internal-only ranges.
- The SSO audit extract contains internal service-account IDs — we'll provide a filtered CSV showing only the test account events (timestamp, result, source IP).
- PT report redaction: I'll remove any attacker PII and obfuscate exact hostnames; we'll keep the vulnerability descriptions and risk ratings intact.

Sam — is it acceptable if we share a redacted PDF plus a separate folder with filtered screenshots and a Jira export (the Jira export will be a flattened text file, no attachments)? Also, we'll include a compensating-controls checklist in plain text describing:
  * WAF rule IDs applied and timestamps
  * Temporary IP allowlist duration (start/end UTC)
  * Admin MFA enforcement date and roll-forward plan
  * SIEM rule name + ptr to our internal runbook (we'll share the public runbook excerpt)

If that format works, I'll finalize and post the Drive link.

Monica
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finco.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finco.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-19 10:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up - request for remediation evidence

Thanks, Monica — that works. Please:

- Keep the Drive folder permission to 'anyone with link' for now (we'll download and attach to our SIG).
- Include the Jira text export and the PT report PDF.
- Please mark in the compensating-controls memo the concrete rule IDs and the window for the temporary allowlist (we need exact timestamps to validate).

Also: can you add a screenshot showing the post-fix blocking behavior (e.g., the test request being blocked by the WAF with a 403 and the corresponding WAF alert entry)? That artifact is particularly useful for our auditor.

Appreciate the quick turn.
Sam
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20 15:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up - request for remediation evidence

Sam —

Package uploaded: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cDefGH_pt_evidence_package

Included artifacts (brief):
- redwood-pt-report-202605.pdf (redacted; v1)
- fw-allowlist-snapshot-olga-20260618.png (annotated; internal ranges blurred)
- waf-block-403-screenshot.png (shows test request blocked + timestamp)
- jira-PT-4878-thread-extract.txt (status transitions + comments)
- sso-test-account-audit.csv (filtered to test account events only)
- compensating-controls-memo.txt (WAF rule IDs: WAF-9912, WAF-9934; allowlist window: 2026-05-10T18:12:00Z to 2026-05-10T22:50:00Z; admin MFA enforced: 2026-05-11T02:00:00Z)

Notes:
- We redacted hostnames and internal-only IP ranges as discussed.
- The WAF-block screenshot includes the alert entry exported from our SIEM with the matching timestamp.
- Jira PT-4878 is public-facing export; any private attachments were omitted.

If you need a notarized or stamped report for procurement, let me know (we can provide an attestation letter).

Olga
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
